tema: Mixed Conditionals — Past Choices, Present Results

cast_dialogue.linea: Mixed conditionals cross time, heroes: a past that didn't happen explains a present that isn't. 'If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.'
If I had studied photography at university, I would be a famous artist now. But I'm happy anyway.
If I hadn't learned to cook as a teenager, I wouldn't own a ramen restaurant today.
I wouldn't be living in Medellín if I had accepted that job in Bogotá. Best decision of my life!
If I hadn't moved to this street in 1975, none of these friendships would exist. The past plants, the present harvests.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Mixed conditional: if + past perfect (unreal PAST) + would/wouldn't + infinitive (unreal PRESENT). One decision in the past changes who you are TODAY. Compare: third conditional = past condition, past result ('would have been').

if + past perfect, would have + pp
If I had studied, I would have passed.

guion: Sofía: Do you ever think about the past, Ben?
Ben: Sometimes. If I had studied photography at university, I'd be a famous artist now.
Sofía: Maybe. But you're talented anyway. I wouldn't be living in Medellín if I had accepted that job in Bogotá.
Ben: Really? You never told me that!
Sofía: Yes. And Kenji wouldn't own a restaurant if he hadn't learned to cook as a teenager.
Ben: It's true. One decision years ago changes everything today.
Sofía: Exactly. And if Abuela Carmen hadn't moved to this street, we wouldn't be friends now.

reading.texto: If Ben had studied photography at university, he would be a famous artist now. Sofía wouldn't be living in Medellín if she had accepted that job in Bogotá. And if Kenji hadn't learned to cook as a teenager, he wouldn't own a ramen restaurant today. The past shapes the present: one decision years ago, one life today. If Abuela Carmen hadn't moved to this street in 1975, none of these friendships would exist.
